scope: Shared rules included in avatar-mode luna_input exports. Minimal mode selector, project clip library, full/left/right compositions, prompt manifest and manual image upload implemented. Circle and bulk ZIP mapping are not implemented.
planning_order: Read the current voiceover and word timings, not reference captions or old embedded planner instructions.
Identify chapter structure and semantic spans: hook, claim, example, action, cause, consequence, comparison, number, verdict, transition.
Choose matching visuals for those spans, then avatar layout and concise graphics.
Assign voiceover-aligned durations and source offsets. Review acquired assets before finalizing framing.
Export AI-photo prompt manifest and check avatar reuse and duration-based 50/50 background mix.

explanatory_visual.graphic_rule: Use diagrams only when relations or processes need explanation; the first reference has about 10.9% whole graphic scenes, with additional overlays.

countdown_practical.graphic_rule: Consistent chapter cards and a few number/range cards. The second reference has about 6.15% whole text-card scenes. Do not require faceless graphic quotas.
countdown_practical.ordering: Follow the script numbering and order. A countdown is optional, never imposed on every niche.
countdown_practical.payoff: Allow the promised final point more time if the script develops it; do not make chapters equal in duration.

avatar.purpose: Full avatar for direct address, warning, judgment, and transitions; side panel for simultaneous explanation and example; optional circle when it leaves an illustration readable. Do not insert on a periodic timer.
avatar.coverage_is: planning target, not a universal rule or implemented UI setting
avatar.panel_side: left or right, selected consistently per project from image composition; do not mirror the source video to change sides
avatar.library: 3–5 ~10s clips of one woman wearing a niqab; mute clip audio, no lip sync; choose suitable trimmed intervals, vary clips and framing, avoid adjacent identical gestures; inspect loops before using; if an interval is too short cut to b-roll instead of freezing/stretching
avatar.hold_duration: Follow the semantic span. Observed median scene duration 3.4–3.5s is not a fixed template length.

broll.selection: Illustrate the action and the relationship in the sentence, not just a shared noun. A mechanism may require full-screen detail; a warning may require a visible consequence.
broll.technical_match: Inspect downloaded/generated assets. Automatic/manual selector, pedal count, product version, place and period must match the narration. Reject confusing substitutes such as a gaming controller for a car selector unless the script explicitly makes that analogy.
broll.prepared_visuals: A hot glow, cutaway, arrow or document highlight may already be baked into an image. Do not classify all of these as motion-graphics templates.
broll.camera: Move smoothly toward the relevant visible area; zoom out when revealing context; derive framing from the actual image. Use fit/contain with a designed or blurred filler if cropping would hide an important object.
broll.metaphor: Use metaphor images only when the narration expresses an analogy; literal cause/action passages need the relevant subject.

source_mix.include: backgrounds beside panel avatars and underneath circles
source_mix.balance: Globally and across chapters without mechanical source alternation; do not infer the reference real/AI ratio from appearance.

graphics.chapter_card: Parameterize number, heading, optional subtitle, theme and duration; use the current script and Coolvetica. Position over the chapter introduction span, not automatically only on the isolated number word.
graphics.number_card: Parameterize exact value/range, unit and short caption; preserve factual qualifiers from the script. Numbers in reference scenes 334/360 are examples, not hardcoded defaults or verified service advice.
graphics.density: Select graphics by explanatory need, not a mandatory 30–34% quota inherited from faceless mode.
graphics.timing: Entrance, readable hold and exit fit the semantic scene duration; six reference samples establish phase order but not exact easing or frame-level onset.

ai_prompt_manifest.text_in_images: Keep exact chapter headings, labels and numbers in rendered text layers; do not depend on generated lettering.
ai_prompt_manifest.identity: Use an agreed fictional presenter identity; do not copy the reference narrator biography or claim fifty years of work experience.
ai_prompt_manifest.import: User generates in Google Flow. Map outputs by asset IDs or preview confirmation; ZIP ordering is not an identity. Bulk ZIP mapping still needs implementation.

review: Each visual supports the corresponding script span.
Avatar does not obscure the object or diagram.
Source clip offset and duration are within bounds; master voiceover preserved.
No adjacent identical avatar gesture; library identity consistent.
Text is readable, numbers and qualifications match the script.
Real/AI balance measured by background time, overlapping layers counted once.
limits: No model-weight training has occurred; rules are persisted project artifacts.
Two references do not establish every niche or montage style.
SFX timing, gain and music in reference audio were not measured; user SFX gain 30% remains a separate production preference.
Media-generation provenance and technical claims in the reference are not verified.
